# ZetsApp

> ZetsApp builds and sells custom software, AI solutions, and ready-to-use SaaS products for startups and enterprises. We also publish in-depth engineering guides and host a directory of business software with pricing, features, and reviews.

ZetsApp helps businesses **build**, **buy**, and **compare** software:
- Custom software development (web & mobile apps)
- AI & machine learning services (LLM apps, AI agents, RAG pipelines)
- AI automation for business workflows and processes
- SaaS products ready to adopt today
- A searchable directory of business software (CRM, HR, security, AI, collaboration, and more)

## About
- [About ZetsApp](https://www.zetsapp.com/about): Who we are, how we ship, and where we work — company positioning, engineering process, and compliance posture (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2).

## Services

- [RAG Development](https://www.zetsapp.com/services/rag-development): Custom Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems with GDPR-safe deployment.
- [Full-Stack Development](https://www.zetsapp.com/services/full-stack-development): End-to-end web and mobile engineering across MERN, MEAN, .NET, Django, Rails.

- [Hire Developers in Dubai](https://www.zetsapp.com/services/hire-developers-dubai): Full-stack, AI, RAG, and mobile engineers for UAE clients.
- [Hire Developers in the UK](https://www.zetsapp.com/services/hire-developers-uk): GDPR-safe, IR35-friendly developers for UK and EU clients.

## Regional Presence
- [Software Development in Dubai / UAE](https://www.zetsapp.com/locations/dubai): DIFC / DMCC / IFZA-friendly, UAE-hour delivery, AED or USD invoicing.
- [Software Development in London / UK / EU](https://www.zetsapp.com/locations/london): GDPR-safe, EU-region hosting, IR35-friendly contracting.
- [Custom Software Development in the USA](https://www.zetsapp.com/locations/united-states): HIPAA and SOC 2-aware, US-hour overlap, W-9 supplier, USD invoicing.
